top_signals.title: US Air Force chief of staff discusses ‘regional situation’ with Israeli military officials
top_signals.summary: U.S. Air Force Chief of Staff Ken Wilsbach visited Israel recently and met with Israel Defense Forces and Israeli Air Force top officials.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rebalancing, 'Boomer Candy,' Index Fund's 50th | ETF IQ 8/31/2026
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: AllianceBernstein Global Head of ETFs Julie Gunts, Farther Asset Management CIO Nick Panitsas, Tweedy Browe Managing Director John Spears, and Hedgeye Asset Management Portfolio Manager Brooks Cutright. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Solana fees hit record as validators double pace of inflation cuts
top_signals.summary: Less new supply of SOL will reach the market every year, which also means validators will earn less for the same amount of work.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
